premarket.market_expectations: Markets are positioned for a bullish session with strong overnight gains in US indices and favorable domestic cash flows, though elevated US yields and dollar strength may cap upside. The long bias is supported by declining volatility and previous session's strong closing position, but Brent crude's sharp drop adds a note of caution. Earnings reports will drive stock-specific action while global inflation data remains a watchpoint.
